definitions.explanation: The beginning of a new calendar year, especially the first few days of January. A very important holiday period in Japan.

examples.japanese: {新年|しんねん}⟦{明|あ}けまして→明ける：03251_akeru⟧おめでとうございます。
{新年|しんねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：02003_mukaeru⟧。
{新年|しんねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{抱負|ほうふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{語|かた}る。
examples.english: To talk about New Year's resolutions.

notes:
{新年|しんねん} refers to the New Year, one of the most important holidays in Japan.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {新年|しんねん}{明|あ}けましておめでとうございます: Happy New Year (formal greeting)
- {新年|しんねん}を{迎|むか}える: to welcome the New Year
- {新年|しんねん}の{挨拶|あいさつ}: New Year's greetings
- {新年会|しんねんかい}: New Year's party

RELATED TERMS:
- {正月|しょうがつ}: New Year (especially Jan 1-3)
- ⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：05426_nengajou⟧: New Year's card
- {初詣|はつもうで}: first shrine visit of the year

NOTE: Do not confuse with {信念|しんねん} (conviction, belief), which has the same reading.
